_comment: Bleakhold Royale v1 terrain (royale-spec.md sections 2.1-2.4): a 3x3-tile solo free-for-all battle royale.
World X is north, Y is west; the block spans X and Y -1066.67..533.33, centre C (-266.67, -266.67). A
jittered cliff ring closes the edge (no holes: players drop in anywhere). Three rings: A the keep (5201),
B the outer landmarks (5202-5205, early game), C the inner sites (5206-5212) where the storm ends. Every
final_site is at most 490 yd from C (the storm chain reaches 540); Farm, Pit and Shrine are never final.
The Overlook (5213) is the lobby mesa in the north-west corner: a flatten 'raise' 25 yd above the local
ridge with ~76 degree sides, an invisible BG collision ring on its rim. Three river crossings: the Old
Ford, the Covered Bridge and the Pit Bridge. Roads are 6-7 yd dirt; 'scatter' groups add the cover.
Textures: grass, dirt and rock everywhere, plus one regional fourth layer per chunk (river shore and
the Mirefen pond, the keep's paved courtyard, the farm's fields), kept a chunk apart (MCNK: 4 layers).
'pois' feed the server's bh_royale_poi table (package.py writes the SQL): the lobby, landmarks and
crossings (ids = area ids), crates (param 1 common, 2 strongbox; crates inside WMOs take their z from
the WMO via z_from), Shadow Sight orbs, buff orbs (param 1 speed, 2 restoration, 3 berserk), supply
sites and final sites (weight). Chests and orbs are server GameObjects, not terrain doodads.
Every texture and model path is in the verified 3.3.5a asset kit (scratchpad assets/kit.json: base
MPQs of a clean client). Placements carry no 'bounds': MODF extents and footprints come from 'radius'
(the kit's size estimates); rebuild on the VPS with --assets for the real model boxes, and check the
Pit Bridge deck and the covered bridge there.

areas._: subzones 5201-5213 (zone.subzones copy the zone row: ARENA + NO_FLY); first match wins

features._: rolling cover hills: Crow's Rise, Graves, Caravan, the Mirefen dome hollow, Siege
the Pale Shrine hill (the highest ground), its flat top and the guard tower's shoulder pad
Blackvein Pit: a sunken bowl at z 4.2
Mirefen: lift the hollow floor to 2.6 (dry), then a pond basin under the 1.8 water
the river, north edge to south edge, east and south of the keep
Old Ford: a raised shallow crossing (wading depth under the 3.0 water line) and its ramps
Pit Bridge abutments: dry banks at the deck ends (deck facing 103/283)
Gloomtimber Mill terrace and the lumbermill's pad
ramps up the keep plateau (SE and NW)
the closing ring: a foothill ridge, then a ~72 degree cliff wall (walkable limit 50)
The Overlook: the lobby mesa, 25 yd above the local ridge, sides of about 76 degrees

texture_rules._: global: dirt patches in the open ground
global: the roads (the 'roads' list) paint here
global: worn ground in the farm yard, the pit floor, the mill yard and the lobby
regional: shore mud along the river and around the Mirefen pond
global: rock on steep ground (border cliffs, the mesa, plateau sides)
